scope: Original public imperative/manual MatLegacyTable construction with the twelve-argument CdkTable16 constructor, including supplied custom view-repeater strategy
constraint: Current minimum CdkTable exposes a protected _viewRepeater field and chooses its default strategies at ngAfterContentInit; custom-strategy preservation through a protected lifecycle adapter needs proof and is not ruled out. The full original twelve-argument constructor also supplies ViewportRuler and a coalesced style scheduler. Current parents obtain their own ViewportRuler through injection and declare viewport/scheduler state private. A signature-only adapter that ignores those supplied objects would conceal lost behavior. Direct current-private token/member use or a CDK fork violates supplied implementation rules. No complete stable-public-only adapter has been established.
proposed_owner_choice: Either explicitly exclude this original manual-construction path from the published compatibility contract, or retain it and keep release readiness blocked until a compliant implementation exists.
remaining_supported_scope_under_proposal: Automatic Angular-created legacy tables, public data/render APIs, original boolean input behavior and public recycleRows behavior retain their separate native evidence; no exemption covers other API, DI, source-policy or full audit failures.
approval: Not granted. No constructor waiver, exception, golden, release baseline or support statement changed.
native_evidence: table-boolean-input-source-proof.json, table-recycle-row-source-proof.json and native90 constructor/identity cases concern distinct supported paths and do not prove the removed custom strategy contract.
correction: The earlier rationale incorrectly described _viewRepeater as private/no public assignment route. Both authenticated minimum declarations actually mark it protected. The pending choice concerns the whole original manual construction path; no exclusion or approval is inferred from the corrected rationale.
